versions.content: Definition of enumeration types In the AUTOSAR meta- model, an enumeration is not implemented by means of an ApplicationCompos- iteDataType . Instead, a discrete set of integer numbers can be used as a structural description for a single ApplicationPrimitiveDataType or an ImplementationDataType of category VALUE or TYPE_REFERENCE that boils down to an Implementation- DataType of category VALUE . The mapping of the integer numbers to labels in the scope of the definition of an enu- meration is considered part of the semantical definition via an attached CompuMethod rather than part of the structural description.
